description: Unit test class for PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProvider, testing its applicability and authentication extraction logic using mocked HTTP request contexts.

classes.name: PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProviderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProvider, verifying its methods and behavior.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test setup, creating mock headers, request context, and provider instance.

methods.name: isApplicableWithDummyAuthHeader
methods.description: Tests if the provider recognizes applicability with a dummy auth header.

methods.name: isApplicableWithDummyAuthQueryParam
methods.description: Tests if the provider recognizes applicability with a dummy auth query parameter.

methods.name: isApplicableWithDummyAuthQueryParamAndDummyAuthHeader
methods.description: Tests if the provider correctly recognizes applicability when both header and query param are present.

methods.name: isApplicableFails
methods.description: Checks provider returns false when neither header nor query param are present.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationFails
methods.description: Verifies that authentication extraction fails when no header or query is present.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationFailsWithEmptyDummyAuthHeader
methods.description: Tests failure when the dummy auth header is empty.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationFailsWithEmptyDummyAuthQueryParam
methods.description: Tests failure when the dummy auth query parameter is empty.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationByHeader
methods.description: Verifies successful authentication extraction when dummy auth header is provided.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationByQueryParam
methods.description: Verifies successful authentication extraction from query parameter.

methods.name: doExtractAuthenticationByQueryParamAndHeader
methods.description: Checks extraction when both header and query parameter are present.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResultExtractsDittoRuntimeExceptionFromCause
methods.description: Ensures that the failure reason is correctly extracted from nested exceptions.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Verifies that a failure result contains the expected exception.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Tests the correctness of the authorization context type returned for a request.

methods.name: mockRequestContext
methods.description: Helper method to create a mocked RequestContext with optional header and query parameter.
